--TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.BOB_TBLCORPENROLLMENT

DECLARE @DATETOPROCESS DATE
SET @DATETOPROCESS = '2024-05-31'

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPENROLLMENT_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPENROLLMENT_SELECT_SRC
(
                ID,
                BOFO_FLAG,
                CORP_ID,
                CORP_LOGO_CHOICE,
                CREATED_BY,
                CREATED_DT,
                DEL,
                ENROLLMENT_CLOB,
                EXPIRY_DT,
                EXT_REMARKS,
                FIELD1,
                FIELD2,
                FUNC_CD,
                OTP_TYPE,
                PARENT_REF_NO,
                PIN,
                REF_NO,
                SERVICE_WF_CLOB,
                SIGNATORY_CLOB,
                SMS_NO,
                STATUS,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DT,
                VERSION,
                BNK_CODE,
                FILE_NAME,
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)


SELECT 
                ID,
                BOFO_FLAG,
                CORP_ID,
                CORP_LOGO_CHOICE,
                CREATED_BY,
                CREATED_DT,
                DEL,
                ENROLLMENT_CLOB,
                EXPIRY_DT,
                EXT_REMARKS,
                FIELD1,
                FIELD2,
                FUNC_CD,
                OTP_TYPE,
                PARENT_REF_NO,
                PIN,
                REF_NO,
                SERVICE_WF_CLOB,
                SIGNATORY_CLOB,
                SMS_NO,
                STATUS,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DT,
                VERSION,
                LEFT(FILE_NAME,5),
                FILE_NAME,
				1 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPENROLLMENT]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPENROLLMENT_SELECT_SRC
(
                ID,
                BOFO_FLAG,
                CORP_ID,
                CORP_LOGO_CHOICE,
                CREATED_BY,
                CREATED_DT,
                DEL,
                ENROLLMENT_CLOB,
                EXPIRY_DT,
                EXT_REMARKS,
                FIELD1,
                FIELD2,
                FUNC_CD,
                OTP_TYPE,
                PARENT_REF_NO,
                PIN,
                REF_NO,
                SERVICE_WF_CLOB,
                SIGNATORY_CLOB,
                SMS_NO,
                STATUS,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DT,
                VERSION,
                BNK_CODE,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                CC.ID,
                CC.BOFO_FLAG,
                CC.CORP_ID,
                CC.CORP_LOGO_CHOICE,
                CC.CREATED_BY,
                CC.CREATED_DT,
                CC.DEL,
                CC.ENROLLMENT_CLOB,
                CC.EXPIRY_DT,
                CC.EXT_REMARKS,
                CC.FIELD1,
                CC.FIELD2,
                CC.FUNC_CD,
                CC.OTP_TYPE,
                CC.PARENT_REF_NO,
                CC.PIN,
                CC.REF_NO,
                CC.SERVICE_WF_CLOB,
                CC.SIGNATORY_CLOB,
                CC.SMS_NO,
                CC.STATUS,
                CC.UPDATED_BY,
                CC.UPDATED_DT,
                CC.VERSION,
                CC.BNK_CODE,
                CC.FILE_NAME,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.BOB_TBLCORPENROLLMENT CC
            JOIN [d360].[STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPENROLLMENT] B
            ON CC.ID = B.ID
            AND CC.BNK_CODE = LEFT(B.FILE_NAME,5)
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPENROLLMENT_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPENROLLMENT_GROUP_SRC
(
                ID,
                BOFO_FLAG,
                CORP_ID,
                CORP_LOGO_CHOICE,
                CREATED_BY,
                CREATED_DT,
                DEL,
                ENROLLMENT_CLOB,
                EXPIRY_DT,
                EXT_REMARKS,
                FIELD1,
                FIELD2,
                FUNC_CD,
                OTP_TYPE,
                PARENT_REF_NO,
                PIN,
                REF_NO,
                SERVICE_WF_CLOB,
                SIGNATORY_CLOB,
                SMS_NO,
                STATUS,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DT,
                VERSION,
                BNK_CODE,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
                ID,
                BOFO_FLAG,
                CORP_ID,
                CORP_LOGO_CHOICE,
                CREATED_BY,
                CREATED_DT,
                DEL,
                ENROLLMENT_CLOB,
                EXPIRY_DT,
                EXT_REMARKS,
                FIELD1,
                FIELD2,
                FUNC_CD,
                OTP_TYPE,
                PARENT_REF_NO,
                PIN,
                REF_NO,
                SERVICE_WF_CLOB,
                SIGNATORY_CLOB,
                SMS_NO,
                STATUS,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DT,
                VERSION,
                BNK_CODE,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                ID,
                BOFO_FLAG,
                CORP_ID,
                CORP_LOGO_CHOICE,
                CREATED_BY,
                CREATED_DT,
                DEL,
                ENROLLMENT_CLOB,
                EXPIRY_DT,
                EXT_REMARKS,
                FIELD1,
                FIELD2,
                FUNC_CD,
                OTP_TYPE,
                PARENT_REF_NO,
                PIN,
                REF_NO,
                SERVICE_WF_CLOB,
                SIGNATORY_CLOB,
                SMS_NO,
                STATUS,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DT,
                VERSION,
                BNK_CODE,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPENROLLMENT_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                ID,
                BOFO_FLAG,
                CORP_ID,
                CORP_LOGO_CHOICE,
                CREATED_BY,
                CREATED_DT,
                DEL,
                ENROLLMENT_CLOB,
                EXPIRY_DT,
                EXT_REMARKS,
                FIELD1,
                FIELD2,
                FUNC_CD,
                OTP_TYPE,
                PARENT_REF_NO,
                PIN,
                REF_NO,
                SERVICE_WF_CLOB,
                SIGNATORY_CLOB,
                SMS_NO,
                STATUS,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DT,
                VERSION,
                BNK_CODE
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @DATETOPROCESS;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.BOB_TBLCORPENROLLMENT A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPENROLLMENT_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BNK_CODE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BNK_CODE,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1


INSERT INTO EDS.BOB_TBLCORPENROLLMENT
(
                ID,
                BOFO_FLAG,
                CORP_ID,
                CORP_LOGO_CHOICE,
                CREATED_BY,
                CREATED_DT,
                DEL,
                ENROLLMENT_CLOB,
                EXPIRY_DT,
                EXT_REMARKS,
                FIELD1,
                FIELD2,
                FUNC_CD,
                OTP_TYPE,
                PARENT_REF_NO,
                PIN,
                REF_NO,
                SERVICE_WF_CLOB,
                SIGNATORY_CLOB,
                SMS_NO,
                STATUS,
                UPDATED_BY,
                UPDATED_DT,
                VERSION,
				SCD_START_DATE, 
				SCD_END_DATE, 
				ISACTIVE, 
				ISLATEST, 
				BNK_CODE, 
				SOURCE_CODE, 
				FILE_NAME, 
				insert_dttm
)
SELECT
                SRC.ID,
                SRC.BOFO_FLAG,
                SRC.CORP_ID,
                SRC.CORP_LOGO_CHOICE,
                SRC.CREATED_BY,
                SRC.CREATED_DT,
                SRC.DEL,
                SRC.ENROLLMENT_CLOB,
                SRC.EXPIRY_DT,
                SRC.EXT_REMARKS,
                SRC.FIELD1,
                SRC.FIELD2,
                SRC.FUNC_CD,
                SRC.OTP_TYPE,
                SRC.PARENT_REF_NO,
                SRC.PIN,
                SRC.REF_NO,
                SRC.SERVICE_WF_CLOB,
                SRC.SIGNATORY_CLOB,
                SRC.SMS_NO,
                SRC.STATUS,
                SRC.UPDATED_BY,
                SRC.UPDATED_DT,
                SRC.VERSION,
				@DATETOPROCESS,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				SRC.BNK_CODE,
				'BOB',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPENROLLMENT_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
